description: This file defines the OutOfRangeException class, a custom exception used in the Apache Commons Math3 library to indicate that a given argument is outside the specified range. It inherits from MathIllegalNumberException and includes information about the lower and upper bounds that were violated.

classes.name: OutOfRangeException
classes.description: A specialized exception indicating that a numerical argument is outside the specified bounds.

methods.name: OutOfRangeException(Number wrong, Number lo, Number hi)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with the provided incorrect value and bounds.

methods.name: OutOfRangeException(Localizable specific, Number wrong, Number lo, Number hi)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with specific localization context and bounds.

methods.name: getLo()
methods.description: Returns the lower bound related to the exception.

methods.name: getHi()
methods.description: Returns the upper bound related to the exception.
